metadataRaw.title: How to INSTANTLY Relieve Gluteus Minimus Pain
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe demonstrates simple exercises to quickly relieve tightness and pain in the gluteus minimus muscle.

The gluteus minimus is a buttock muscle located in the deep posterior hip region.

When this muscle becomes strained or inflamed, it can cause pain across the buttocks, hip, and down into the leg and calf.

This pain often stems from a combination of muscle weakness and tightness, which leads to strain and inflammation.

To relieve this, we’ll focus on both lengthening and strengthening the glutes—providing quick relief and long-term results.

Each exercise targets the gluteus minimus in a unique way. For best results, try them all and stick with the ones that bring you the most relief.

Let us know which one works best for you!

Chapters: 
0:00 Intro
1:04 Standing Hip Abduction
2:38 Clamshell/Figure-4 Combo
4:59 90-90 Stretch
7:08 Side Leg Lift (Strengthening)
9:23 Step Up (Strengthening)
